integrity: The claim has an analytic proof; standard-library finite numerical/rational checks are supplementary. Earlier equilateral-triangle value and weaker convex-cycle bound are credited as existing. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp area/halving-chord inequality is proved only for nondegenerate Euclidean triangles. No claim is made for all convex cycles. Full text of Grüne 2008 thesis was inaccessible; possible historical overlap is noted.
title: Sharp triangle area bound and complete classification of shortest perimeter-halving chords
